# Create the platform specific library.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

message (VERBOSE "Processing 'tests/platforms/${PLATFORM_NAME}/'...")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define the platform library.
add_library (micro-os-plus-platform-interface INTERFACE EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

target_include_directories (
  micro-os-plus-platform-interface INTERFACE "include"
)

target_sources (
  micro-os-plus-platform-interface INTERFACE "src/hooks.cpp"
                                             "src/led-green.cpp" "src/wraps.c"
)

target_compile_definitions (
  micro-os-plus-platform-interface
  INTERFACE
    # Full POSIX conformance:
    # https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/basedefs/V1_chap02.html#tag_02_01_03
    _POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L
    # For S_IREAD
    _GNU_SOURCE
    # Default is 0x800 (2 KB); full (non-nano) Newlib's vfprintf/_svfprintf can
    # overflow that. 0x1000 (4 KB) is the maximum obtainable this way, since the
    # stack is reserved out of the 4 KB SCRATCH_Y bank; going further requires
    # relocating the stack into main RAM via a linker script override.
    PICO_STACK_SIZE=0x1000
    # runtime_init_default_alarm_pool() (pico_time) unconditionally claims a
    # hardware alarm and arms its IRQ during runtime_init, even though this
    # platform never uses add_alarm_*/sleep_*; that armed-but-unhandled
    # machine-timer IRQ was hitting the SDK's weak isr_riscv_machine_timer
    # placeholder (an ebreak). Skip it.
    PICO_TIME_DEFAULT_ALARM_POOL_DISABLED=1
    # The first SDK hardware initialisers are called explicitly, in the SDK
    # order, from micro_os_plus_startup_initialise_hardware_hook() (hooks.cpp),
    # to have the clocks available early; exclude them from __preinit_array, so
    # that they run only once.
    PICO_RUNTIME_SKIP_INIT_BOOTROM_RESET=1
    PICO_RUNTIME_SKIP_INIT_PER_CORE_BOOTROM_RESET=1
    PICO_RUNTIME_SKIP_INIT_EARLY_RESETS=1
    PICO_RUNTIME_SKIP_INIT_USB_POWER_DOWN=1
    PICO_RUNTIME_SKIP_INIT_CLOCKS=1
    PICO_RUNTIME_SKIP_INIT_POST_CLOCK_RESETS=1
)

set (
  xpack_platform_common_args
  -march=rv32imac_zicsr_zifencei_zba_zbb_zbs_zbkb
  -mabi=ilp32
  -mstrict-align
  -fno-math-errno
  -fno-exceptions # it fails at run-time.
  # -fno-move-loop-invariants Embedded builds generally must be warning free,
  # but PICO SDK does not allow this. -Werror -flto fails to run on QEMU.
  # $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-flto> $<$<CONFIG:MinSizeRel>:-flto>
  $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-fno-omit-frame-pointer>
  # ... libs-c/src/stdlib/exit.c:132:46
  # $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:GNU>:-Wno-missing-attributes> parameter passing for
  # argument of type
  # 'os::rtos::memory::allocator_stateless_default_resource<os::rtos::thread>'
  # changed in GCC 7.1 $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:GNU>:-Wno-psabi>
  # $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-fxxx>
  # https://cmake.org/cmake/help/v3.20/manual/cmake-generator-expressions.7.html?highlight=compile_language#genex:COMPILE_LANGUAGE
  # $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-exceptions>
  # $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-rtti>
  # $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-use-cxa-atexit>
  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-threadsafe-statics>
  # Turn off many warnings, the Pico SDK throws a lot of them.
  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-Wno-c++-compat>
  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-Wno-missing-prototypes>
  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-Wno-nested-externs>
  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-Wno-bad-function-cast>
  -Wno-undef
  -Wno-arith-conversion
  -Wno-padded
  -Wno-missing-declarations
)

target_compile_options (
  micro-os-plus-platform-interface INTERFACE ${xpack_platform_common_args}
)

# When `-flto` is used, the compile options must be passed to the linker too.
target_link_options (
  micro-os-plus-platform-interface
  INTERFACE
  # -v
  ${xpack_platform_common_args}
  -nostartfiles
  # --specs=rdimon.specs -Wl,--start-group -lgcc -lc -lc -lm -lrdimon
  # -Wl,--end-group Force the linker to keep the interrupt vectors which
  # otherwise are not referred from anywhere. -u_interrupt_vectors nano has no
  # exceptions. -specs=nano.specs
  -Wl,--gc-sections
  -Wl,-z,max-page-size=4096
  -Wl,--wrap=main
  -Wl,--wrap=__libc_init_array
)

if ("${CMAKE_C_COMPILER_VERSION}" VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL "12.0.0")
  target_link_options (
    micro-os-plus-platform-interface INTERFACE
    # .elf has a LOAD segment with RWX permissions (GCC 12)
    -Wl,--no-warn-rwx-segment
  )
endif ()

# Do not link `pico_stdlib` (or `pico_runtime`): it brings in
# `pico_clib_interface`, `pico_stdio`, `pico_printf` and `pico_malloc`, which
# redefine or `--wrap` the newlib syscalls, `exit()`/`_exit()`,
# `printf()`/`puts()`/`vsnprintf()` and `malloc()`, colliding with the µOS++
# startup and semihosting implementations. µOS++ owns everything from the C
# library down; the SDK provides only the boot image, the linker script, the
# reset entry (crt0) and the hardware drivers.
target_link_libraries (
  micro-os-plus-platform-interface
  INTERFACE micro-os-plus::device
            pico_standard_link
            pico_crt0
            pico_platform
            pico_runtime_init
            hardware_clocks
            hardware_gpio
            hardware_hazard3
            micro-os-plus::startup
)

xpack_display_target_lists (micro-os-plus-platform-interface)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Aliases.
add_library (micro-os-plus::platform ALIAS micro-os-plus-platform-interface)
message (VERBOSE
         "> micro-os-plus::platform -> micro-os-plus-platform-interface"
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
